## Description

Constructs directed information flow adjacency matrices using Transfer Entropy, feeding directed graphs into Graph Neural Networks to forecast cascading credit and market shock contagion.

## Where it may fit

Systemic banking crisis propagation, inter-bank credit contagion, supply chain bankruptcy cascades.

## Vehicles

Systemic Risk Management Groups, Credit Arbitrage Desks, Global Macro Funds.

## Required data

Corporate inter-firm credit matrices, supply chain networks, asset return tick series.

## Caveats

Directed adjacency matrix estimation is sensitive to sliding window length selection.
